title.narrative: Lärandepartnerskap om systeminnovation med Climate KIC
Systems Innovation Learning partnership with Climate KIC - Learning partnership with Climate KIC

description.narrative: Partnerskapet mellan Sida, Nederländska UD och Climate KIC syftar till att accelerera lärandet om hur man kan arbeta med systeminnovation som ansats i praktiken genom att dela ideer, verktyg, erfarenheter och att utforska nya sätt att hantera utvecklingsutmaningar. Kapaciteten att leda i komplexitet ska öka hos de som deltar och genom att dela erfarenheterna från konkreta exempel kan fler lära. Partnerskapet ska aktivt utökas med fler lärandepartner.

The Systems Innovation Partnership is created by Climate KIC, Sida and the Dutch MFA with the purpose to accelerate learning of how to work with systems innovation by sharing ideas, tools, methods, and experience, exploring solutions to common challenges and co-developing the systems innovation tools based on new insights. Capabilities and mindsets of those involved will be strengthen to enable them to lead in complexity. Through the advancement of current and new examples of where systems innovation is being used as a practical framework, methods, and tools can be spread to other partners. The founding partners will work to bring more actors into the partnership.
